title: Seoul hotel buffets hike year-end prices
caption:
Planning a year-end meal in Seoul? Luxury hotel buffets are reaching record costs this December. A family of four could spend up to 1 million won due to rising labor and import expenses.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul hotel buffets hike year-end prices
